title: Vice Ganda, hinamon si Timmy na mag-host ng “Everybody Sing”
summary: Grouped with “repre-sing-tatives” from Batangas, Timmy stood as the odd one out after he revealed that he came from Baguio, prompting Vice Ganda to challenge him to host "Everybody Sing."
